interpretation: Diagnostic text overlap only; normalization does not establish semantic equivalence or model-training contamination. No rows or labels are changed.

count_definitions.group: One shared normalized-text key; groups are sorted by that key.
count_definitions.duplicate_row_count: All rows in within-split groups containing at least two rows.
count_definitions.left_row_count: Left-split rows in cross-split overlap groups.
count_definitions.right_row_count: Right-split rows in cross-split overlap groups.
count_definitions.row_pair_count: Cross-split row pairs: sum(left rows * right rows) per shared key.
count_definitions.conflicting_label_group_count: Groups containing more than one distinct gold label.
count_definitions.row_order: Rows within each group are sorted lexicographically by original ID.
